about_the_game:
About

Frantic Birdies is a fast paced resource collecting survival game where you can manage and control a lot of birds.

Bird Life

Each bird has it's own resources that it has collected that can be turned into other resources.

With your bird you gather worms for food, twigs to build a nest and lay and hatch an egg to create new bird life that you can control.

Collectable Jewels

Jewels come out as soon as a chick is fully grown. These are collected by your birds and you can deposit the value of them at the tree bank.

Challenge

The game gets frantic as you try to manage many bird's resources and creating new bird life at the same time.

Avoid the bad birds with your birds as they can send your bird crashing and lose the game.

Controls

Keyboard or Xbox Controller (untested on other gamepads)

Highscores

Hatch lots of new birds to beat your birds grown high score and collect more jewels and beat your money high score.

Key Features

  • Control each bird individually

  • You can level up your bird so they get more value from the jewels they collect.

  • The birds each have a random color as they are created.

  • Each bird has its own money wallet. Go to the bank tree to deposit the birds money and add it to your score.

  • You have to manage each bird's resources such as turning twigs into nests, food into eggs and food into bird feed to feed the chicks.

  • You can put your bird to go to sleep in the sleeping hole in the tree so you have twenty seconds without having to manage that bird. You can put up to ten birds in the hole to sleep.

  • Pixel art style graphics.

  • Beat your high score for birds grown and amount of jewels you collect and bank.

  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 M380

  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000

short_description: Frantic bird management survival game. Collect worms, collect twigs, create a nest with twigs, lay eggs and hatch new birds and feed them until they are fully grown. Collect jewels that appear as a bird is fully grown. Avoid the bad birds that can send your bird crashing and lose the game.
